summary: CAPA System Testing - Iteration 60. All backend APIs passed (17/17). Fixed critical frontend bug (SelectItem empty value error). CAPA Dashboard now fully functional within Dragon Automator page.

ui_bugs.issue: SelectItem with empty string value causing React runtime error
ui_bugs.fix_applied: Changed value='' to value='all' with proper conversion logic

backend_apis.GET /api/capa/dashboard: PASSED - Returns correct summary with status/severity distribution
backend_apis.GET /api/capa/list: PASSED - Returns all CAPAs with filtering support
backend_apis.POST /api/capa/automator/create-from-qa: PASSED - Creates CAPA from QA findings

frontend_ui.capa_dashboard: PASSED - Dashboard displays stats (Total, Open, Critical, Closed, Avg Days)
frontend_ui.capa_cards: PASSED - 6 CAPA cards displayed with data-testid attributes
frontend_ui.new_capa_dialog: PASSED - Dialog opens with form validation
frontend_ui.capa_detail_view: PASSED - Shows Overview, Investigation, Containment, Resolution, VOE, History tabs
frontend_ui.status_filter: PASSED (after fix) - Filter dropdown works correctly

critical_code_review_comments: CAPA service uses JSON file storage (/app/data/capa/capas.json) - consider MongoDB for production
All CAPA lifecycle phases implemented: Draft → Investigation → Containment → Resolution → VOE → Closed
Good separation of concerns between service layer and API routes
Frontend component has proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: 6 test CAPAs created during backend testing (prefixed with TEST_CAPA_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: CAPA System fully tested and working. Backend APIs at /api/capa/* all functional. Frontend CAPA Dashboard accessible via Dragon Automator page (/dragon-automator) under CAPA tab. Fixed SelectItem empty value bug in status filter. 6 test CAPAs exist in system for testing purposes.

bug_fix_details.issue: React runtime error: A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string
bug_fix_details.root_cause: SelectItem in status filter had value='' which is not allowed in shadcn/ui Select component
bug_fix_details.fix: Changed value='' to value='all' and added conversion logic: value={filter.status || 'all'} onValueChange={(v) => setFilter({...filter, status: v === 'all' ? '' : v})}
